items.name: Steel Stud (Metal Framing)
items.description: Galvanized steel C-stud, the metal-building equivalent of lumber_stud_2x4 - light-gauge steel framing member used for wall/partition framing in pre-engineered metal buildings, sold in bundles like the existing lumber studs.
items.notes: Queued while filling in the Large Metal Garage growth group's construction_recipe fields - the catalog currently has no steel-frame or metal-siding building materials at all (only roofing_steel_corrugated exists), so a genuinely metal-framed building's recipe can't be built accurately without this. Should slot into a new #steel_framing material tag (assets/_schemas/material_tags.json) analogous to the existing #framing_lumber tag.

items.name: Steel Rigid Frame Beam
items.description: Primary structural I-beam/column for a pre-engineered steel building's rigid frame - the load-bearing skeleton members that carry the roof and wall panels on a metal building, distinct from the lighter steel studs used for infill framing.
items.notes: Queued alongside 1789520000_steel_stud_framing while filling in the Large Metal Garage growth group's construction_recipe - the primary structural members of a metal building's frame (vs. the lighter infill studs) don't exist as a separate catalog item yet.

items.name: Corrugated Steel Wall Siding
items.description: Corrugated steel wall siding panel, sibling to the existing roofing_steel_corrugated item but sized/sold for vertical wall cladding rather than roofing - light-gray/galvanized finish to match a typical metal garage or pole barn exterior.
items.notes: Queued alongside 1789520000_steel_stud_framing and 1789520001_steel_frame_beam while filling in the Large Metal Garage growth group's construction_recipe - the catalog's only existing corrugated-steel item (roofing_steel_corrugated) is explicitly a roofing product, not wall siding, so reusing it for walls would be inaccurate. Should slot into a new #metal_siding material tag once created.
